archetype: Dark & Cinematic Studio (A24 x Apple x Linear x Criterion)
overall_mood: Deep charcoal & obsidian soundstage with warm tungsten spotlight accents, filmic minimalism, and high-precision audio tool design.

theme_decision.rationale: App is an actor's soundstage workbench. Dark mode evokes a cinematic screening room, screenplay reading under stage lighting, and focused sound engineering without digital glare.

typography_strategy.typewriter_font_answer: American Typewriter is a proprietary Apple/Linotype font without an official Google Font web license. To achieve the exact tactile script/typewriter look legally on all platforms while giving Mac users native rendering: We pair Google Font 'Courier Prime' as the primary typewriter webfont, configured in CSS with the fallback stack: font-family: 'American Typewriter', 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace. For display headings, we pair it with 'Syne' (or 'Cinzel' / 'Outfit') for an A24 cinematic editorial feel, and 'JetBrains Mono' for crisp IPA phoneme alignment.

display.name: Syne
display.usage: H1, H2, major hero headings, section titles, brand logo

typewriter.name: American Typewriter / Courier Prime
typewriter.usage: Screenplay lines, script quotes, scene reader text, actor notes, laundry list sound headers

mono_ipa.name: JetBrains Mono
mono_ipa.usage: IPA transcriptions (/əkˈstɛnt/), timecodes (00:01:24:12), dictionary builder keypads, audio wave metrics

body.name: System Sans / Inter
body.usage: General UI body copy, modal text, table cells, form inputs

token_mapping.description: Remap existing legacy light tokens to the new dark cinematic studio palette across all ~20 React components with zero breakages.

spacing_and_layout.generous_padding: Use p-6 to p-12 on main containers to ensure breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.border_padding: All boxed containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 minimum) to prevent text collision.

grid_layouts.word_hero: Centered high-impact single-column grid max-w-4xl with focal spotlight backdrop.
grid_layouts.scene_workspace: 3-pane studio layout: Left Sidebar (Scenes list & PDF upload, w-72 or col-span-3) | Center Workspace (Screenplay reader with line-by-line IPA blocks, flex-1 or col-span-6) | Right Panel (Laundry List phonetic drawer, w-80 or col-span-3).
grid_layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density technical grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with cardless structured containers and tight gaps (gap-4).

subtle_film_and_audio_cues.film_grain: Subtle 2% noise texture on background surface to eliminate flat digital gradients.
subtle_film_and_audio_cues.spotlight_beams: Radial background gradient: radial-gradient(ellipse at top, rgba(229,169,60,0.12) 0%, rgba(10,10,12,0) 70%).
subtle_film_and_audio_cues.clapperboard_icons: Subtle slate icon accents for scenes and recording takes.
subtle_film_and_audio_cues.timecode_badges: Monospace timecode chips (e.g. REC [00:02:14]) in recording queues.
subtle_film_and_audio_cues.vu_meters: Dynamic miniature audio frequency bars during audio playback or microphone recording.

header.style: Glassmorphic floating navbar with backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#121316]/80 border-b border-[#2D303B]/60 sticky top-0 z-50
elements: Brand Logo: 'PRONOUNCE THIS.' in Syne font with amber dot accent
Tab Navigation: Pill-shaped toggle for 'Word' | 'Scene Workspace' with active spotlight slider
Account Chip: User avatar / email chip, subscription status badge ('TRIAL (3 free left)' or 'PRO MEMBER'), sign-in button

word_search_hero.container: bg-[#16171D] border border-[#2D303B] rounded-2xl p-8 relative overflow-hidden shadow-2xl
word_search_hero.input_box: Flex row with sleek input (bg-[#0A0A0C], border-[#383C4A], text-[#F1F2F6], focus:border-[#E5A93C], focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#E5A93C]) and high-contrast amber CTA button ('PRONOUNCE')
word_search_hero.result_card: Hero word presentation in Typewriter font (text-5xl), IPA breakdown (/əkˈstɛnt/) with click-to-play audio wave button, Real Speakers YouTube clip button, 'Did you mean' suggestion pills, and CMU pronunciation note

scene_workspace_3pane.sidebar: Dark slate pane with upload dropzone ('Drag & Drop Audition PDF / Screenplay'), scene list with active screenplay highlight, page count, and clapperboard icon
scene_workspace_3pane.reader: Screenplay viewer formatted in Courier Prime / American Typewriter layout with character speaker tags (e.g., LEO, MARGARET), line-by-line IPA toggle, clickable word chips for instant pronunciation playback, and line recording/download actions
scene_workspace_3pane.laundry_list: Sound categorization panel with tabs for Phoneme Groups (L Sound, T Sound, Rhotic R, Vowels, Diphthongs), practice cards with play/loop controls and audio sample triggers

modals.login_modal: Passwordless magic-link modal with dark stage styling, amber button, and clear email input
modals.paywall_modal: Studio Pro tier comparison modal ($9/mo or $90/yr), 5 free words + 1 free scene trial indicator, Stripe secure badge, high contrast CTA
modals.caption_search_modal: YouTube modal player with cue timecode list, prev/next clip buttons, and transcript line with highlighted target word

sections: Payment Health Banner (Stripe status, active subscriptions count, monthly MRR)
User Table with member grants, trial resets, CSV exports
Recording Queue with live mic waveforms, Record / Stop / Listen / Save / Skip buttons
My Dictionary Builder with IPA symbol palette keypad, progress bar, CMU word editor, preferred pronunciations, hidden videos control

accessibility_and_testing.contrast_standard: All body text meets minimum APCA / WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast against dark background. Accent text uses high legibility amber (#E5A93C or #F3C77C).
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, IPA word chips, audio play buttons, and admin actions MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure tailwind.config.js maps display font to Syne, typewriter font to 'American Typewriter', 'Courier Prime', Courier, monospace, and mono font to JetBrains Mono.
2. Remap paper, surface, ink, muted2, rule, rust, sage in tailwind.config.js to the new dark cinematic colors.
3. Update index.css to load Google Fonts (Syne, Courier Prime, JetBrains Mono) and set global body background to #0A0A0C and color to #F1F2F6.
4. Refactor Header, Word Page Hero, Scene 3-Pane Reader, Laundry Lists, Modals, and Admin Panel using the defined dark stage aesthetic with amber spotlight accents.
5. Retain and add data-testid attributes to all key elements for test verification.
